_doc: Items. 'use' effects run from the inventory / HUD medkit button. price = base price before faction/crisis multipliers.

medkit.name: Medkit (Generic)
medkit.desc: Heals 40 HP. Side effects include a Halcyon invoice.

air_canister.name: Air Canister
air_canister.desc: Pays 30 credits of air debt. Bottled at the source (a vent).

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.desc: Hull junk. Sells for 6 credits each.

data_shard.name: Ledger Shard
data_shard.desc: Proof that someone, somewhere, embezzled. Sells for 80.

synth_keytar.name: Synth Keytar
synth_keytar.desc: Your old instrument. Emotionally priceless. Financially 12 credits.

fake_id.name: Fake ID
fake_id.desc: Says you're 'Dave'. You don't look like a Dave.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.desc: Makes theft quieter: witnesses take longer to notice.

bribe_voucher.name: Bribe Voucher
bribe_voucher.desc: Pre-paid hush money. Silences one witness for free.
